main_text.p: נחיל Ch. Confluxus, collectio: metaphoricè, Collectio, examen apum. Sic Deut.21.8.in Targ.Jonath. נחיל רמורנין Collectio, Examen vermium. Apud Arabes נחלה Apis.
נחם Pahel Ch.Solari, Consolari aliquem. Ithpehal אתנחם Consolationem accipere vel admittere, Consolari se: Item Pœnitere, ut Hebr. Ithpah. אתנחם Idem.
נחמא, נחמא, נחמא Ch. Consolatio. Plur. נחמין, נחמין, נחמתא.
ניחומא Ch. Idem. Plur. ניחומין Consolationes, consolatoria, Zach.1.13. & ex forma fœmin. ניחומתך Psal.49.19, Consolationes tuæ.

ܢܚܡܬܐ Syr. Idem, Joh.11.24.25. Respondet Græco ἀνάστασις, Resurrectio, quæ Consolatio appellatur, quia perfectam consolationem & gaudium afferet electis, juxta D.Tremellii. Sic videtur in Targum intelligendum illud Hof.6.2. יחייננא ליומי נחמתא רעתידין למיתי ביום אחיות מיתיא יקיימנא: Vivificabit nos in diebus consolationum qui venturi sunt, in die vivificationis mortuorum suscitabit nos. Solet alias ubique, duobus locis citatis exceptis, in N.T. hæc vox ἀνάστασις, transferri vel per ܩܝܡܐ; vel per ܐܩܝܡܐ, ܐܩܝܡܐ, a Syro interprete. Unde loca ista D.Bezæ suspecta.

page.notes: Hebrew, Greek and Syriac text is transcribed approximately; several Hebrew/Syriac forms are uncertain and should be checked against the scan. The word at the foot right (נחר) is taken as a catchword.
